Questions people ask

How is South India different from the north?
Greener, slower, hotter and more humid. Different food, different architecture, different languages. Many people who have done the Golden Triangle come back for this.
When should we go?
October to March. The monsoon arrives in June and the hills stay comfortable through most of the year.
Can we combine north and south?
Yes, with a domestic flight in the middle. Allow at least two weeks for both to be worth doing.
Is a houseboat night worth it?
For most guests, yes. A night on the backwaters is quiet in a way very little else in India is.
